businessProblem: A subscription meal-kit business is losing customers fast and has no follow-up or loyalty mechanism in place; the owner wants to know why retention is collapsing.

evidence.finding: Monthly churn rose to 9% with one-time buyers now dominating new cohorts
Repeat purchase rate fell from 61% to 38% over two quarters
No post-purchase follow-up, win-back, or loyalty program currently exists
Contribution margin remains healthy and positive on retained customers
